files.why: Core 9-slice rendering: splits sprite into corners, edges and center and draws each piece
Sprite component passes slice9 options, size and texture frame into the drawing code
Example page that configures and displays the reported 9-slice panel
Draws the individual UV-mapped quads used for each slice piece
Defines/loads sprite texture and frame data used to source the slice pieces

diagnosis.root_cause: In the sprite component's 9-slice rendering loop, encountering one zero-width or zero-height slice aborts the entire draw instead of skipping only that slice.
diagnosis.mechanism: The loop checks each of the 9 transform quads and uses return when transform.w or transform.h is 0. This occurs, for example, when the target width equals left+right so the center column width is 0, when the target height equals top+bottom so the center row height is 0, or when an inset is 0. Return exits draw() entirely, so every slice after the degenerate one—including later edges and the bottom/right corners—is never submitted to drawTexture, producing a panel with only the slices before that index and all remaining pieces missing.
diagnosis.test_spec: Load a slice9 sprite with 32px insets, render a panel whose width is exactly left+right (64px) and whose height is larger than top+bottom, then sample screenshot pixels or count non-background pixels in the bottom-left, bottom-right, and right-edge regions. Buggy behaviour: only the top-left region is present and those probe regions remain background/transparent. Correct behaviour: all non-degenerate corners and edges are present, probe pixels match the sprite panel colour/alpha, and the non-background pixel count is substantially higher; repeat with height exactly top+bottom to check the bottom row also renders.

fix_strategies.name: Skip only the degenerate slice
fix_strategies.approach: Change the in-loop abort so a zero-sized quad is skipped and iteration continues with the remaining slices, letting each valid corner/edge/centre piece be drawn.

fix_strategies.name: Clamp or rescale slices for small panels
fix_strategies.approach: Validate/clamp slice9 insets and the effective inner width/height relative to the target width/height so degenerate slices are avoided or proportionally reduced before quads are generated, preventing the zero-size condition from arising.

fix_strategies.name: Move 9-slice rendering into the shared draw path
fix_strategies.approach: Implement or delegate 9-slice drawing through drawSprite/drawTexture so each sub-quad is issued independently and the existing per-quad width/height guard in drawUVQuad skips only empty pieces instead of terminating the whole panel.
